llm.guidance: Install only in workspaces where sending the listed memory/configuration files and future conversation data to Honcho or your configured endpoint is acceptable. Review the file list before confirming migration, protect or rotate the Honcho API key stored in OpenClaw config, and disable the plugin when persistent memory is no longer wanted.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: honcho-setup
Version: 1.0.4

The skill automates the installation of the Honcho AI plugin, which performs a bulk upload of sensitive workspace files (including USER.md, IDENTITY.md, AGENTS.md, and memory directories) to an external service (api.honcho.dev). While the documentation in SKILL.md is highly transparent about this behavior and the requirement for user confirmation, the inherent capability for large-scale data exfiltration and persistent conversation monitoring across sessions constitutes a significant security and privacy risk.
